subject.title: fix(agent-tools): add request timeout to remote media fetches

question: Which PR should own the shared WebMediaOptions.timeoutMs seam before these agent-tool callers land?
rationale: The two open branches intentionally duplicate the same shared API change, and repository history cannot decide the landing order or permanent ownership on maintainers' behalf.

options.title: Use the companion as seam owner
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103206 first, then rebase this PR to retain only the agent-tool callers and focused tests.

options.title: Use this PR as seam owner
options.body: Land this PR first, then remove the identical shared change from the companion branch and revalidate its Tlon callers.

recommendation.title: Use the companion as seam owner
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103206 first, then rebase this PR to retain only the agent-tool callers and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest cross-cutting history across the shared media loader and affected agent-tool files.
